items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I was with the Charlie Ventura band in ‘49. And there was an alto player who is in this picture, Boots Mussulli. He was with that band

ctx.x: I have a picture here that you might recall.
Stan the Man. Oh my goodness. Wow. Buddy Childers, Boots Mussulli — now I’ve got to read the caption underneath. I’m not sure where that was.
